paper_title: Uncovering the Genetic Links of SARS-CoV-2 Infections on Heart Failure Co-Morbidity by a Systems Biology Approach
study_design: Cross-disease analysis of independent public COVID-19 and HF transcriptomic datasets, followed by enrichment, protein-interaction and regulatory-network analyses, and external expression-dataset evaluation
evidence_type: Public gene-expression differential-expression analysis, pathway enrichment, PPI topology, external PBMC expression evaluation, and computational TF/miRNA and drug-signature prioritization
claim: Independent COVID-19 and HF expression analyses yielded a 12-gene shared transcriptomic signature.
context: Overlap was calculated across separately profiled disease datasets, not in a cohort of people with both COVID-19 and HF.
reported_evidence: [{"label":"DEG threshold","value":"|log2FC| > 1 and adjusted P < 0.05"},{"label":"COVID-19 DEGs","value":"102"},{"label":"HF DEGs","value":"253"},{"label":"shared genes","value":"12: S100A8, ABCB1, S100A11, PTGS2 (COX2), LY96, XCL1, RORA, CCL11, CCL4, S100A12, BCL2 and AQP9"}]
source_locator: Results: Identification of shared transcriptomic signature between HF and COVID-19; Figure 1B-D
scope_does_not_establish: ["Germline genetic correlation, inherited susceptibility, GWAS evidence, Mendelian randomization, or genetic causality.","A causal SARS-CoV-2-to-HF mechanism or findings from a dedicated cohort simultaneously affected by COVID-19 and HF.","Prospective clinical validation, diagnostic accuracy, or prognostic utility of a five-gene panel.","Experimentally demonstrated TF/miRNA regulation or direct measurement of gut microbiome dysbiosis, intestinal permeability, or circulating LPS.","Proteomic evidence or therapeutic efficacy of glutathione, muramyl dipeptide, or another intervention."]
limitations: ["Human evidence was assembled retrospectively from heterogeneous public expression datasets; no dedicated simultaneous COVID-19 and HF cohort or prospective clinical validation was reported.","Lung tissue, cardiac tissue, and PBMC samples and their experimental platforms are not directly interchangeable.","The GSE147507 human COVID-19 lung component had one deceased COVID-19 biological donor with technical replicates and two independent uninfected donors; total GEO Series entries are not a participant count.","GSE9128/GDS3115 evaluated 11 pooled PBMC microarray samples rather than 11 independent participants, although the original population comprised 24 HF and 12 control individuals.","The exact GSE26887 grouping that generated the article-reported 253 HF DEGs is not sufficiently explicit in the accessible main article; the formal Series contains 19 HF and five control cardiac-tissue samples.","PPI, TF/miRNA and drug-signature findings are computational or database-derived and lack direct causal perturbation validation.","Gut-microbiome composition, intestinal permeability and circulating LPS were not directly measured; gut-heart interpretation remains a hypothesis.","No proteomics, candidate-compound treatment experiment, or demonstrated therapeutic efficacy for glutathione or muramyl dipeptide was reported."]
single_finding_matrix_scope: ["Overlap was calculated across separately profiled disease datasets, not in a cohort of people with both COVID-19 and HF."]
export_notice: Study-level author-maintained evidence summary. Not participant-level data and not a ready-to-pool meta-analysis dataset. For formal citation, use the original article DOI.
